title: Remove duplicates from a sorted array in place
answer: For a sorted array, use a write pointer. Scan from left to right; because equal values are adjacent, copy a value only when it differs from the last unique value already written. The method returns the new logical length, and the first `length` positions contain the unique values. AeroTopo's `deduplicateSorted` method implements this in O(n) time and O(1) extra space. The unused tail of the original array should be ignored because in-place removal cannot physically shrink a Java array.
